message.content:
This vertical rectangular illustration is a magazine cover with a lime-green background and a red vertical border on the left. At the top, the white capital letters "TEMPO" are partially obscured by a dark, dense, textured black cloud. Above the title, three short headlines in black capital letters are separated by slanted lines: "TEKA-TEKI CALON DIREKTUR BANK JABAR", "PERANG BUNGA DEPOSITO", and "BAGAIMANA MAYANG DIHABISI".

Centered on the right side is a cartoon man with tan skin, dark hair, and a slender build, wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and black trousers. He stands in profile, looking upward toward the cloud. He holds a closed, bright red umbrella by its hooked handle, pointed toward the ground. His shadow is cast on the ground beneath him. To his left, large black text reads "AKU RAPOPO," followed by a smaller paragraph: "Bagaimana Jokowi berkelit dari kepungan koalisi Prabowo."

In the bottom left corner, a barcode sits beside the price "RP 35.000", a URL, and publication details. The date "13-19 OKTOBER 2014" appears below the magazine title.
